title: UnicodeEncodeError on non‑latin1 cookie values
detail: The code assumes all cookie header values are latin‑1 encodable. If a cookie contains characters outside the latin‑1 range, `encode("latin1")` will raise a `UnicodeEncodeError`, causing `parse_cookie` to crash. This can happen with user‑supplied cookies containing Unicode keys or values.

title: Unexpected kwargs passed to http.parse_cookie
detail: The `http.parse_cookie` function does not accept a `cls` keyword argument (or any kwargs). Passing `**kwargs` from the sans-IO wrapper will raise a TypeError when `cls` is supplied, breaking callers that rely on the deprecated `cls` parameter.

title: Incorrect file object check
detail: The condition now skips processing for any non‑None file object, causing all valid file handles to be ignored and resulting in missing data in the encoded payload.
